title: Ho Ho Ho (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar warm baritone male vocal 106bpm upright bass brushed snare dry wit observational true story family Christmas father character portrait celebratory
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, Christmas feel, warm and slightly chaotic]
December twenty-fourth.
Eight oh five PM.
Chas McIvor sends his Christmas message.
The punctuation is his own.

[Verse 1]
Ho comma ho comma ho
Merry Xmas
Double exclamation mark
Image attached
That is the full Christmas message
From Charles Rodney McIvor
To his children
On the twenty-fourth of December
At eight oh five in the evening
The commas are in there
They are not an accident
They are Chas punctuating his ho ho ho
Individually
As he sees fit

[Verse 2]
Then he tried to call on Christmas morning
Five fifty-three AM
No answer
Tried again at five fifty-four
No answer
Tried at six oh three
Still nothing
He was awake at five fifty-three AM on Christmas Day
Trying to call his kids
Because that's what you do
When you are Chas McIvor
At Christmas
At five fifty-three in the morning

[Chorus]
Ho comma ho comma ho
Merry Xmas
Double exclamation
Image omitted but he sent one
Ho comma ho comma ho
Five calls on Christmas morning
Ho comma ho comma ho
He kept trying
Because that's what Christmas is
For Chas
Multiple attempts
And the punctuation of a man
Who puts the commas where he wants them

[Bridge - spoken, warm and exact]
We are awake.
That's what he texted at six oh three PM.
After the kids finally reached him.
We are awake.
Double exclamation.
The family was spread across time zones.
Chas was awake at both ends of the day.
Ready.
At five fifty-three AM.
Ready.
At six oh three PM.
Always awake for the Christmas call.
Ho, ho, ho.

[Verse 3]
He wishes he could be there
That's what he said
When Corey described the birthday party
Sounds great wish we could be there
The exclamation mark at the end
That one too
Is for real
He means it
He always means it

[Outro - piano alone, settling into Christmas evening]
Ho comma ho comma ho
Merry Xmas
Double exclamation
Image attached
Chas McIvor
Christmas morning
Five fifty-three AM
Calling his kids
Because that is what Christmas is
Ho
Ho
Ho
